IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.foreign_keys WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'FK_$table$_$referenced_table$_$column$') AND parent_object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'$table$'))
    ALTER TABLE dbo.$table$ DROP CONSTRAINT FK_$table$_$referenced_table$_$column$
GO

ALTER TABLE dbo.$table$
ADD CONSTRAINT FK_$table$_$referenced_table$_$column$ FOREIGN KEY($column$)
REFERENCES dbo.$referenced_table$ ($column$)
ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION
